Followed the 2022 paper §2.6 and Fig. 5 to check the reference sensors and lever arrangement. Kept only press-bench files; no human measurements are contained or requested here.
reference: One-axis load cell and a separate industrial six-axis reference mounted in series on a manually loaded press. Sessions 1/2 used Nano25, session 3 Delta (paper §2.6/Fig. 5, confirmed change of serial in files). Positions 0/5/10 mm in session 2 vary relative to the ONE-axis transducer center. Reference moments remain about the six-axis instrument origin. The release lacks a common calibrated six-axis output on the low-cost side, an extrinsic reference-frame transform and independently certified wrist zero. No subject/clinical data included.
units: Six-axis file header kg is interpreted as kgf and converted via standard gravity 9.80665. Compression is reported as minus Fz. Session 3 kg-cm interpreted as kgf cm ×0.0980665; first two use N-m. One-axis native columns have no header; retain raw second column for scalar regression, no arbitrary calibration into SI. Six-axis header states 10 Hz. Both streams contain 50 readings per equivalent trial but common per-sample timestamps are unavailable; summaries and regressions pair the two file means, never individual rows.
fit: Fit ordinary least squares with intercept only to 21 training file means; freeze coefficients for both author-defined held-out sessions. This is a deliberate one-channel baseline; does not estimate the authors’ geometry-aware 3-parameter lever model and its errors are not paper-reported test errors. Archive filenames do not specify the individual lever arm offset; no invented per-file geometry labels.
limits: The paper gives 500 N and 495 N longitudinal maxima for Nano25 and Delta in its setup. Three Delta file-average compressions exceed 495 N after explicit unit conversion, including a borderline 495.09 N; two greatly exceed it (737.54 and 943.71 N). Retain values as published; compare against a stated measuring range, not an overload, clipping or calibration certificate. No independent saturation or permanent drift conclusion follows.
reproduce: Save publisher ZIP as load.zip in the input directory; python derive_press.py INPUT_DIR OUTPUT_DIR using NumPy. Both source-member hashes are preserved for every trial.
